title: Construct an explicit dyadic A1 multiplicity operator (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with an exact finite matrix certificate, produced by Nick Petalas. Construct an explicit dyadic multiplicity operator for the historical A_1 dihedral component W:

```text
216-dimensional pinned orbit space
    -> C=[V,RV], with rank C=128 and image C=W
    -> C^-1 (A_1|W) C = diag(T,T)
    -> T=K/8, K an explicit 64-by-64 integer matrix
```

K has 668 nonzero entries in [-64,96]. Each column of V has two or three nonzero entries. The least common denominator of T in this basis is exactly eight.

This is a partial constructive answer to unpaidmoon #7065's Open next question 2. That question asks for an integer matrix of T. The new rational matrix and its actual intertwiner are explicit; an invariant lattice giving an integer T remains open. K represents 8A_1, so its factor of eight is retained. The predecessor's polynomial is a cited premise, not a replay target. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Credit unpaidmoon #7065, head `ee0202a8eafa4c0b84bef97ecfb5691f6affc9c6`, for W, its generators and the explicit-matrix question; #6964 for the pinned orbit basis and B=4A_1; #6944/#7008/#7023 for the splittings; JoyboyBrian for the handoff; aliromman #4958/#4720 for the query/Bell action; krzysztofwojt for the one-slot polynomial; and the retained #1719 lineage. Related Nick Petalas annihilator/width results are background, not steps of this construction.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19571932). Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; the formal-interface-lemma card changes scope to this constructive algebraic side result.

## Evidence

Before, #7065 supplies the polynomial square and leaves the multiplicity matrix unconstructed. After, the new deterministic construction emits all entries of K and V and checks their complete operator and dihedral identities.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only:

- Both warning-strict normal/optimized direct checks and both registered VERIFY commands pass. Each registered command was also timed separately at 0.214 and 0.215 seconds, below its 120-second limit. These are timeout checks, not performance comparisons.
- A separate dense integer product checks all 27,648 entries of `2BC=C diag(K,K)`. Independent dense modular elimination proves rank C=128. Exact scaled-projector, rotation and reflection identities identify its image with W and expose the same T on both copies. Nine semantic controls pass.
- Metadata/source pins, in-memory Python compilation, function-size inspection, diff whitespace, committed-byte and declared source-history checks pass. The publication preflight checks nine package/input files at `bf5e56f3d62d13f632f6e9934112367831539600`.
- The generated matrix/basis certificate has canonical SHA256 `98ceb6e760b187a30e185e3b5dcd4041018801bca9ea0d60c94631001e86e7f7`. Receipts bind all six package files and all three live inputs. No receipt is handwritten. No predecessor executable is imported.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/a1-dihedral-multiplicity-matrix/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/a1-dihedral-multiplicity-matrix/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-dihedral-multiplicity-matrix
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/a1-dihedral-multiplicity-matrix --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace that executable. Add `--matrix` to a direct command to emit the complete new matrix and basis. Optional `--emit /absolute/new/scratch/result.json` creates a source-bound receipt outside the checkout and refuses to overwrite an existing file. Expected marker: `PASS_A1_DIHEDRAL_MULTIPLICITY_MATRIX`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is exact linear algebra on one historical pinned operator. T is dyadic, not integral in this basis. The polynomial consequence `chi_T=q` uses #7065 as a cited premise; neither q nor its degree-128 square is recomputed. No new nullity, full stabilizer census, physical decoder, basis-conversion tariff, native/rounded execution, dirty restoration, ownership/storage/tape bill, compiler closure, supplier admission or multiplication theorem is supplied. No selected cold replay, predecessor degree-216/881 replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No local package obligation is deferred to CI alone.

## Open next questions

- Construct an explicit invariant lattice giving an integer T with a sparse intertwiner. Begin with the emitted K/8 and retain the conversion denominators.
- Bind this decomposition to an actual physical consumer and price source/target access, basis conversion, restoration and the full recursive invoice. The complete physical cost is unknown.

Live main/merged searches and local claims were checked again before committing. The broad helper reports complete remote pagination and incomplete sparse local-note coverage, supplemented by Git-tree searches. Unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain outside coverage.

Closeout refreshed this account's open PRs created after the CLAIM at `2026-11-12T18:22:45Z`: #7461 through #7468. The only other result on this same historical A_1 operator is #7463, already listed above; its zero spectral projector is a different arithmetic quantity. The other packages concern phase-preserving widths, a selected binary address map, chronological compiler width, helper recharts, robust coordinate pairing and tensor-prefix integrality. No new computation was run to compare their results, and no shared numerical disagreement was identified.

## CI notes

```text

Neither file is changed by this six-file package addition. This is a repository-level mismatch on main.

The dependent [package replay job 131402870660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43280441536/job/131402870660) was skipped because plan failed.
